prompt: In ~/proj/ledger.py write class Ledger with open(name), deposit(name, amount), withdraw(name, amount), transfer(src, dst, amount), balance(name) and history(name) (list of (kind, amount) tuples, kinds "deposit", "withdraw", "transfer_in", "transfer_out"). Use Decimal and round to cents. Raise KeyError for unknown accounts, ValueError for non-positive amounts or duplicate open, and InsufficientFunds (your own exception, subclass of Exception) when a balance would go negative. A failed transfer must change nothing.
verify: python3 -c "from ledger import Ledger; l=Ledger(); l.open('a'); l.deposit('a', '0.10'); l.deposit('a', 0.2); print(l.balance('a'))"
